readme.content:
The open-source registry for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
Discover, search, and publish MCP servers. Self-hostable. Community-driven.

Quick Start · Features · Architecture · API · Deploy · Contribute

--- ## Why MCP Marketplace MCP (Model Context Protocol) is the universal standard for connecting AI to tools. Adopted by Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, Google, and donated to the Linux Foundation. There are now **thousands** of MCP servers — but no open-source way to discover them. **MCP Marketplace is the npm registry for MCP servers.** - **Search** across the entire MCP ecosystem - **Validate** that servers actually implement MCP correctly - **Rate** and review servers based on real usage - **Publish** your own MCP servers to the registry - **Self-host** your own internal MCP directory --- ## Features - **Full-text search** across server names, descriptions, and categories - **Automated health checks** — validates each server is alive and MCP-compliant - **Category browsing** — 26 categories from smart home to finance - **Community ratings** — star and review MCP servers - **GitHub auto-import** — crawls awesome-lists and discovers new MCPs - **API-first** — REST API for programmatic access - **Self-hostable** — run your own instance with Docker --- ## Architecture ```mermaid graph TD User[🔍 Developer] --> Web[Next.js Frontend
Search + Browse + Submit] Web --> API[FastAPI Backend
Search + CRUD + Validation] API --> DB[(PostgreSQL
Server Registry)] API --> Crawler[GitHub Crawler
Auto-discover MCPs] API --> Health[Health Checker
MCP Compliance Validation] Crawler --> GitHub[GitHub API
Awesome Lists + Topics] Health --> Servers[MCP Servers
Ping + Schema Check] style Web fill:#4A90D9,stroke:#333,color:#fff style API fill:#28a745,stroke:#333,color:#fff style DB fill:#FF9900,stroke:#333,color:#fff ``` --- ## Quick Start ### Option 1: Docker (Recommended) ```bash git clone https://github.com/ALLBOTSIO/mcp-marketplace.git cd mcp-marketplace cp .env.example .env docker compose up -d ``` Open `http://localhost:3000` — the marketplace is pre-loaded with 200+ MCP servers. ### Option 2: Manual Setup ```bash # Backend cd api pip install -r requirements.txt uvicorn main:app --reload # Frontend cd web npm install npm run dev ``` --- ## Project Structure ``` mcp-marketplace/ ├── web/ # Next.js 14 frontend │ ├── app/ │ │ ├── page.tsx # Homepage with search │ │ ├── server/[id]/ # Individual MCP server page │ │ │ └── page.tsx │ │ ├── category/[slug]/ # Category listing │ │ │ └── page.tsx │ │ └── submit/ # Community submission form │ │ └── page.tsx │ ├── components/ │ │ ├── SearchBar.tsx # Full-text search component │ │ ├── ServerCard.tsx # MCP server display card │ │ ├── CategoryGrid.tsx # Category browser │ │ ├── RatingStars.tsx # Star rating component │ │ └── HealthBadge.tsx # Health status indicator │ ├── package.json │ └── tailwind.config.ts ├── api/ # FastAPI backend │ ├── main.py # API entrypoint │ ├── routes/ │ │ ├── search.py # Full-text search endpoint │ │ ├── servers.py # CRUD for MCP servers │ │ ├── categories.py # Category management │ │ ├── ratings.py # Community ratings │ │ └── submit.py # Public submission endpoint │ ├── services/ │ │ ├── health_check.py # MCP server validation │ │ ├── github_crawler.py # Auto-discover from GitHub │ │ └── importer.py # Import from awesome-lists │ ├── models/ │ │ └── schema.py # Pydantic models │ ├── requirements.txt │ └── Dockerfile ├── registry/ │ ├── schema.json # MCP server registration schema │ ├── validators/ │ │ └── mcp_validator.py # Validates MCP compliance │ └── crawlers/ │ └── github_crawler.py # Discovers MCPs from GitHub ├── data/ │ └── seed.json # Pre-loaded with Alexa-MCPs catalog ├── deploy/ │ ├── docker-compose.yml │ ├── vercel.json │ └── railway.toml ├── .env.example ├── CONTRIBUTING.md ├── LICENSE └── README.md ``` --- ## API Reference ### Search MCP Servers ```bash GET /api/search?q=spotify&category=music-audio&limit=20 ``` Response: ```json { "results": [ { "id": "spotify-mcp", "name": "Spotify MCP Server", "github_url": "https://github.com/marcelmarais/spotify-mcp-server", "description": "Full Spotify control via MCP", "category": "music-audio", "stars": 450, "health_status": "healthy", "last_checked": "2026-04-10T12:00:00Z", "rating": 4.8 } ], "total": 1, "page": 1 } ``` ### List Categories ```bash GET /api/categories ``` ### Get Server Details ```bash GET /api/servers/{id} ``` ### Submit a Server ```bash POST /api/submit Content-Type: application/json { "name": "My MCP Server", "github_url": "https://github.com/org/repo", "description": "What it does", "category": "productivity" } ``` ### Health Check Results ```bash GET /api/servers/{id}/health ``` --- ## Health Check System Every registered MCP server is automatically validated: 1. **Repository check** — Is the GitHub repo accessible and not archived? 2. **MCP schema check** — Does it expose valid MCP tool definitions? 3. **Connectivity check** — Can it accept MCP connections? 4. **Freshness check** — Has the repo been updated in the last 6 months? ```mermaid graph LR Cron[⏰ Cron Job
Every 6 hours] --> Check[Health Checker] Check --> Repo[GitHub API
Repo Status] Check --> Schema[MCP Schema
Validation] Check --> Connect[MCP Connection
Test] Check --> Fresh[Last Commit
Check] Repo --> Status{Status} Schema --> Status Connect --> Status Fresh --> Status Status --> Healthy[✅ Healthy] Status --> Degraded[⚠️ Degraded] Status --> Dead[❌ Dead] ``` --- ## Importing Data ### From Alexa-MCPs catalog ```bash python api/services/importer.py --source ../Alexa-MCPs/catalog.json ``` ### From awesome-mcp-servers ```bash python api/services/github_crawler.py --repo wong2/awesome-mcp-servers ``` ### From GitHub topics ```bash python api/services/github_crawler.py --topic mcp-server ``` --- ## Deploy ### Vercel + Railway ```bash # Frontend on Vercel cd web && vercel deploy # Backend on Railway cd api && railway deploy ``` ### Docker Compose (Self-hosted) ```bash docker compose up -d ``` Runs: Next.js frontend (port 3000) + FastAPI backend (port 8000) + PostgreSQL (port 5432) --- ## Roadmap ```mermaid graph TD A[✅ MVP: Search + Browse + Submit] --> B[🔄 GitHub Pages Static Site] B --> C[🔄 MCP Server SDK Integration] C --> D[🔄 One-click Install to Claude Desktop] D --> E[🔄 Automated Compatibility Matrix] E --> F[🎯 1,000+ MCP Servers Indexed] style A fill:#28a745,stroke:#333,color:#fff style F fill:#4A90D9,stroke:#333,color:#fff ``` --- ## Related Projects - **[awesome-voice-ai](https://github.com/ALLBOTSIO/awesome-voice-ai)** — 150+ voice AI tools - **[Alexa-MCPs](https://github.com/ALLBOTSIO/Alexa-MCPs)** — 200 MCP servers for voice assistants - **[voice-agent-starter](https://github.com/ALLBOTSIO/voice-agent-starter)** — Production voice agent template --- ## License [MIT](LICENSE) — AI Venture Holdings LLC
